description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Project model, testing CRUD operations, image handling, publishing, and referential integrity within the Goteo project.

classes.name: ProjectTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing the Project model functionalities, including creation, validation, editing, publishing, and deletion.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Project class and returns the instance.

methods.name: testCount
methods.description: Verifies database counting functions for different project statuses and nodes.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Checks validation and saving failure of a new Project instance without proper data.

methods.name: testCreateUser
methods.description: Deletes existing test user and project to prepare for subsequent tests.

methods.name: testCreateProject
methods.description: Creates a new project with test data, associates it with a test user and node, and verifies the creation.

methods.name: testEditProject
methods.description: Updates project data and images, saves, and verifies modifications and galleries.

methods.name: testRebaseProject
methods.description: Rebases project ID to a new value and verifies changes.

methods.name: testGetProject
methods.description: Retrieves project variants (mini, medium) and widget, verifying their instances and IDs.

methods.name: testRemoveImageProject
methods.description: Removes images from the project, verifies gallery counts, adds images back, and tests image management.

methods.name: testAccountProject
methods.description: Fetches and updates the associated account data for a project, verifying fee changes.

methods.name: testPublishProject
methods.description: Publishes the project, verifies status change to in campaign and published date.

methods.name: testAccountFeeProject
methods.description: Checks that account's PayPal field can be cleared and saved properly.

methods.name: testDeleteProject
methods.description: Removes a project and confirms deletion.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests that fetching a non-existent project throws ModelNotFoundException.

methods.name: testCleanProjectRelated
methods.description: Assesses referential integrity across related project tables, expecting no orphaned records.
